stack: Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn-style (zinc/new-york) + Radix

bad_guidance.why: Only the 'numeric role uses tabular lining figures' clause was usable; the rest (define a type scale, body >=16px web / 14 desktop / 24 TV, generate with tokens.py) is a from-scratch type-system record delivered on an existing shadcn type system whose typography slot the direction itself marked preserved.

Entered the bundle with zero marginal concepts/concerns (marginal.new_critical/required/recommended/concerns all empty). Its 'sorted by value' rule is also wrong for the daily time series, where order is meaningful; usable only for the by-key bars.

Two pre-registered critical concepts are absent from the bundle: state.loading_empty_error (every settings route in this codebase ships loading.tsx + error.tsx; 'states' was a required concern and stayed uncovered) and navigation.orientation_and_back (a new settings sub-page is unreachable until it is added to SettingsNav; never demanded at all).

guidance_ignored.why: Used only the tabular-figures clause. Building a new type scale or changing body size would have broken the preserved shadcn typography.

misses.what: navigation.orientation_and_back never demanded for a create-a-new-page request on an existing multi-tab settings shell; a new route that is not added to the nav is unreachable.

state.loading_empty_error demanded only as 'recommended' although 'states' was a required concern and the project ships loading.tsx/error.tsx per route; it then lost the bundle-selection race and was reported 'not surfaced'.

Bundle stopped at 4 records with a soft cap of 6 while three required concerns (states, interaction, accessibility) were uncovered and named candidates existed (layout-states-empty-loading-error, a11y-focus-visible, a11y-keyboard-operable).

comp-kpi-tile was the top-scoring carrier (0.511) for both critical data concepts but was omitted for 'no positive task evidence' on a sentence that says 'showing this month's API calls against the plan quota' — a KPI screen by definition.

Direction fingerprint reports card_geometry 'none' and corner_language 'sharp' for a codebase whose every surface is a rounded-lg shadcn Card with shadow-sm; harmless only because the cards/surface slots were marked preserved.
